name: Tatooine Transit StarSpeeder 1000
description: The Tatooine Transit StarSpeeder 1000 was a modified StarSpeeder 1000 spacecraft used by interstellar travel agency Star Tours to operate flights bound for the Outer Rim planet Tatooine prior to 0 BBY. This starship was painted blue and light grey with the Aurebesh letters Nern and Dorn. It was named after the planet itself as well as Tatooine Transit, a separate spaceliner company from Star Tours, and a fellow member with Star Tours in the Galactic Tourist Bureau.
